sources.snippet: Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3 is a language model that can follow instructions, complete requests, and generate creative text formats. It is an instruct version of the Mistral-7B-v0.3 generative text model fine-tuned using a variety of publicly available conversation datasets. This model is ready for non-commercial use.
